summary: More than most people, you swing between a need to be seen and to matter and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you shine and lead without trying; other days you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: More than most people, you swing between a need to be seen and to matter and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you shine and lead without trying; other days you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you. The work is holding both without picking a side. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people. Power may not feel neutral here. It can register as something tied to safety, control, and the need to protect yourself.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let identity and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
